title: NextBrain Case 1 · P1.3 fine anatomy
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Learn fine regional assignments within their original reconstructed tissue block and matching ex vivo MRI context. Compare whole-section orientation with a magnified view of the same physical point.
